name: Dragon’s Breath Spell (Metamagic, Mythic)
body:
Your breath spell lingers, inflicting continued damage to enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Dragon’s Breath Spell.

Benefit(s): A target damaged by a dragon’s breath spell you cast suffers the same damage in the following round unless they succeed at a second saving throw.
